posts.name: 38-mind-dark-school-mornings
posts.caption:
Permanent daylight saving time would send US kids to school in the dark over a billion more times, a new study estimates 🌑

University of Washington researchers modeled school start times and sunrise in 14 states, then scaled up to the whole country. Fatal crashes involving school age pedestrians were about twice as likely on dark mornings, but the study does not say how many extra crashes the change would cause.

Source: Rodríguez Ferrante, de la Iglesia et al. (University of Washington), “Over a billion more dark-morning school commutes for K-12 children under the Sunshine Protection Act”, Current Biology, 2026.
